children: – Oman Air and Adhwaa Al Ardh Al Satiaa have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to bring 30,000 visitors from Indonesia to Salalah during 2027.
Under this agreement, Adhwaa Al Ardh Al Satiaa will purchase 30,000 seats on Oman Air flights operating from Jakarta to Salalah via Muscat, paired with curated tourism packages showcasing Dhofar.
Leaders from both organisations highlighted that the partnership supports Oman Vision 2040 by expanding tourism from Southeast Asia and positioning the Sultanate as a leading year-round destination.

title: ZAWYA: Oman Air expands tourism with new agreement for Indonesian travellers
